ahmadrasheed2m
nodes.text: China is grappling with a rise in respiratory illnesses, including #HMPV, Influenza A, and Mycoplasma pneumonia. Reports suggest overwhelmed hospitals, unverified claims of a state of emergency, and growing concerns about the rapid spread of these viruses. 2/3

nodes.author: ahmadrasheed2m
nodes.text: While the virus surge is concerning, the response in China seems reactive rather than proactive and the CCP is trying its best to censor the news. 3/3
